# Changelog

## 0.1.x (current development line)

### Highlights

- Added integrated in-window search UX:
  - always-visible search bar
  - compact dropdown results list
  - keyboard navigation (`Ctrl+F`, `F3`, `Enter`, `Esc`)
- Improved search result readability:
  - friendlier titles
  - subtle `Type:` metadata
  - shortened IDs
- Refined search result row spacing and compact sizing for better visual balance
- Added detached raw SVG panel workflow
- Expanded ChatP&ID UX:
  - local chat persistence
  - markdown export
  - settings integration
- Ongoing docs modernization and consistency updates

## 0.1.0 (MVP)

Initial release of DEXPI Studio.

### Core capabilities

- Open DEXPI XML/JSON files
- Render diagrams via pyDEXPI
- Explore model tree and properties
- Validate model structure
- Export through pyDEXPI exporters
- Dock-based desktop layout with logs and inspector panels
